method: Live @oai/sky one input and refreshed screenshot per action; runtime fingerprint reverified. Significant native frames independently transcribed before implementation. Catalogue names/IDs/units are from the pinned full manual; numerical constants use its explicitly designated CODATA 2014 primary NIST archive. All 52 implementation IDs and 44 conversions are tested. This is not a claim that all hidden simulator digits or every mode algorithm were independently measured.

randomPolicy: Compare range, output precision and state effects, not exact private PRNG stream. Browser Web Crypto supplies independent samples; pure reducer has reproducible fallback state from Y.
limitations: Hidden stored digits in all catalogue constants are not directly measured; historical primary-source values remain explicit.
Full STAT, EQN, MAT, LIST numerical algorithms and general memory workflows remain their later phases. Catalogue scalar entry and existing EQN prompt continuation are covered here.
N-base restrictions are represented for tagged non-decimal state; the physical N-base controller remains Phase 9.
verification: Passed: npm test (312 unit tests, 127 browser tests, 160 golden frames); 7 Django integration tests; compileall; Compose config/build/start; pip dry run; installed wheel/sdist smoke with 16 packaged assets; current parity report; browser inspection; git diff --check.
